title: The Drowned Bell
text: At dusk a bell rises out of the river, green with weed, and rings once by itself. The fishermen say it belonged to the old cathedral, which sank with its congregation still praying. It is very large and very heavy, and it wants to be hung.

options.label: Hang the drowned bell in the Commons, and let its congregation keep watch over the city.

outcomes.text: Every night it rings at the third hour while the drowned congregation stands in the square to listen. The city has never felt so safe.

options.label: Row it out and sink it again before its congregation follows it ashore.

outcomes.text: It goes down ringing. That night every House dreams of water filling its lungs and wakes coughing up weed.

options.label: Melt it down in the Commons forge; good bronze should not go to waste.

outcomes.text: The metal pours like any other, and the Commons is richer for it. Every blade forged from it sings a hymn when drawn.
